reviewerRole: Independent visual critic; no asset or scene authoring
scope: Blender full-source versus runtime still comparison only
verdict: Repair the visible runtime texture-mapping regression before native installation. The detailed v3 source is a viable candidate, but this reduced version does not yet preserve its appearance.
confirmedImprovements: The new source and runtime have a coherent enclosed case with believable corner protectors, straps, bolts, rounded edges and an inset handle. The conspicuous black side punctures noted in the earlier crate are not visible here.
The runtime preserves the source's overall silhouette, shallow depth, lid profile, handle recess and side relief at this coverage.
Paint, rust, worn coating and dirt have readable separation. Dust is concentrated near the base and damage follows many exposed edges instead of a uniform single surface noise.

hardDefects.evidence: source-review-front.png: source at left, runtime at right
hardDefects.observation: The source's three left bars and two right bars are nearly straight painted marks. Several runtime bars are visibly displaced into large triangular zigzags. The broad adjacent panel and overall case silhouette remain aligned, making this an appearance regression rather than intended wear.
hardDefects.likelyCause: Inferred from the visible comparison and collapse method: UV interpolation or texture-coordinate preservation during strong planar simplification. The exact cause has not been inspected in Blender.
hardDefects.requiredCorrection: Retain or restore the source-to-surface mapping, for example by an appropriate UV-preserving reduction or projection/rebake onto the final runtime surface. Inspect a matched material comparison again; a low geometric nearest-surface error alone cannot detect this defect.

otherRisks: The handle-side A7 mark, smaller stencil bars and shipping label also show local angular displacement compared with the source. Include both main faces and the lid in the mapping correction check.

The shallow case proportions are substantially different from the original deep crate, but are internally plausible as a transport case. Preserve uniform scale and verify human-scale purpose, orientation and stable base contact at actual placements.

The repeated raised side pattern and broadly pale lid marking need close native sun/shade review to ensure they read as constructed material and worn paint rather than a soft embossed surface or baked highlight.

The lid has pronounced dents and a split-like seam. They are source features retained in the runtime, not proof of new reduction damage; inspect their backface and shading behavior in a slow oblique native view.
acceptance: Not yet suitable for native installation as the selected replacement because of the conspicuous mapping regression. Native quality, ground contact, motion stability and AAA street acceptance remain unassessed.
